subject: XAUUSD
mission: Convert P02 observations into a causal, non-double-counted, horizon-aware Gold research decision state without allowing price, pathways, positioning, flow, or mechanics to rewrite upstream causal pressure.
hard_rules: P02 coverage must be non-BLOCKED before analysis may start.
All 192 P01 facts must be present in the reasoning ledger; unresolved is valid and is never silently neutral.
Only causal-root-eligible facts may create additive CAUSAL_FUNDAMENTAL contributions.
Every additive contribution has exactly one canonical root-family owner.
Transmission pathways corroborate or contradict non-additively and never become duplicate root votes.
Event shocks do not directly vote Gold direction; they operate through identified root/pathway ownership.
Positioning is state/vulnerability, not live flow and not Direction authority.
Realized transaction flow has its own plane and cannot retroactively create an upstream cause.
Mechanical/forced pressure has its own plane and cannot rewrite causal fundamental pressure.
Structural carry conditions slower priors but has no direct session Direction authority.
Target price can change transmission, model completeness, missing-driver risk, and research permission constraints only.
No 0-100 pressure/confidence/consumption scores are user-facing or decision-authoritative before true-forward calibration.
Proxy evidence remains PROXY; UNKNOWN/PAID/PRIVATE states cap completeness and are never normalized away.
Unstructured source text is not keyword-sentiment scored. It remains unresolved unless a certified semantic adjudication references the exact observation.
P03 produces SHADOW direction/action candidates only; official V3 production permission remains false until P04 promotion.
Unknown, paid, private, proxy, and unresolved evidence is never renormalized away into the observed subset.
